title: 第8章 摆摊
novel_title: 长生修仙，从装备土龙鳞开始
content_zh:
林玄看完，心中一动。

    正好，水灵草和保木芝留在手中用处不大。

    若拿到散修广场上出售，虽要多费些口舌，却能比卖给商铺多得几块灵石。

    至于那三块紫金石，价值实在太高，若是在散修广场出手，未免太过扎眼。

    林玄想了想，觉得还是去九仙商盟出售更为稳妥。

    略作思量后，他取出一张空白信纸，给张百林回了一封。

    信中只说自己巡山途中遇到些小麻烦，所以晚归了一日，并无大碍。

    至于摆摊一事，他正好也有几样东西要卖，到时可以一同前去。

    写完之后，林玄以灵力封住信纸，唤来院中饲养的信鸽，将信件送了出去。

    做完这些，屋中重新安静下来。

    林玄收起信封，吹灭灯火，盘坐到石床之上，缓缓运转起《土元功》。

    窗外，夜色深沉，灯火零落。

    ......

    第二日一早，林玄便出了门。

    张百林约他的地方，就在散修广场外的一株老槐树下。

    林玄到时，张百林已经等在那里，脚边放着一只鼓鼓囊囊的布袋。

    见林玄过来，张百林咧嘴一笑。

    “来了？”

    “走吧，今日早点去，占个好位置。”

    林玄点了点头，便与他一同朝散修广场走去。

    所谓散修广场，其实便是坊市尽头一片较为空旷的青石地。

    平日里，能长期在这里摆摊的，大多都是炼气中期修士。

    今天却多了很多炼气初期修士的身影。

    林玄跟着张百林在广场里慢慢逛着。

    走了没多久，林玄脚步忽然一顿，目光落在一处小摊上。

    摊子不大，只铺了一块旧青布，上面零零散散摆着几张符箓。

    其中几张土黄色符纸，符纹走势虽然略显粗糙，却隐约能看出是土行符一类。

    林玄心中微动，蹲下来看了几眼。

    摊位前的木牌上写着价格。

    【土行符，两块灵石一张。】

    两块灵石，比玄符斋的地行符便宜了一半。

    张百林见林玄停下，也凑了过来，随手拿起一张符箓看了看。

    只看了两眼，便撇了撇嘴，道。

    “这土行符品相也太差了吧。”

    林玄点了点头。

    这张符的符纹虚浮，灵力不稳，只能算是勉强成符。

    品相比玄符斋中售卖的地行符差远了。
content_en:
After Lin Xuan read it, his heart moved.

    It just so happens that Shui Ling Cao and Bao Mu Zhi are of little use if left in hand.

    If you sell it in the casual cultivator square, although it takes a little more effort, you can get a few more spiritual stones than selling it to a shop.

    As for the three purple gold stones, their value is too high. It would be too eye-catching if they were sold in the casual cultivator square.

    Lin Xuan thought for a while and felt that it would be safer to sell it to the Nine Immortals Merchant Alliance.

    After thinking for a moment, he took out a blank piece of letter paper and wrote a reply to Zhang Bailin.

    The letter only said that he encountered some minor troubles while patrolling the mountains, so he returned home a day late, but it was no big deal.

    As for setting up a stall, he happens to have a few things to sell, so we can go together.

    After finishing writing, Lin Xuan sealed the letter with spiritual power, called the carrier pigeon raised in the courtyard, and sent the letter out.

    After doing this, the room became quiet again.

    Lin Xuan put away the envelope, blew out the lights, sat cross-legged on the stone bed, and slowly started the "Tu Yuan Gong".

    Outside the window, the night was dark and the lights were scattered.

    ...

    Early the next morning, Lin Xuan went out.

    The place where Zhang Bailin made an appointment with him was under an old locust tree outside the Sanxiu Square.

    When Lin Xuan arrived, Zhang Bailin was already waiting there, with a bulging cloth bag at his feet.

    Seeing Lin Xuan coming over, Zhang Bailin grinned.

    "Coming?"

    "Let's go, go early today and get a good seat."

    Lin Xuan nodded and walked towards the Sanxiu Square with him.

    The so-called casual cultivator square is actually a relatively empty bluestone field at the end of the city.

    On weekdays, most of the people who can set up stalls here for a long time are monks in the middle stage of Qi refining.

    Today, there are many more monks in the early stage of Qi refining.

    Lin Xuan followed Zhang Bailin and walked slowly in the square.

    Not long after walking, Lin Xuan suddenly stopped and his eyes fell on a stall.

    The stall was not big, just covered with an old green cloth, with a few talismans scattered on it.

    Some of the khaki talisman papers have slightly rough patterns, but it can be vaguely seen that they are earth talismans.

    Lin Xuan's heart moved slightly and he knelt down to take a few glances.

    The price is written on the wooden sign in front of the stall.

    [Earth Talisman, two spiritual stones for one. 】

    Two pieces of spiritual stone are half cheaper than the Earthly Talisman from Xuanfuzhai.

    Seeing Lin Xuan stop, Zhang Bailin also came over, picked up a talisman and looked at it.

    After just two glances, he curled his lips and said.

    "The appearance of this earth element talisman is too bad."

    Lin Xuan nodded.

    The runes on this talisman are superficial and the spiritual power is unstable, so it can only be regarded as a talisman.

    The quality is far inferior to the Earthly Talisman sold in Xuanfu Zhai.
